series.description: Explicit per-measure marks and axis assignments for combo visuals.

step.description: Render line segments as discrete steps between categories.

DashboardApiVersion.description: The only resource version accepted by the canonical dashboard document.

DashboardComboSeries.description: One result-frame measure and its governed combo rendering policy.

DashboardComboSeriesAxis.description: Axis assignment for one governed combo measure.

DashboardComboSeriesMark.description: Marks supported by a governed multi-measure combo series.

DashboardConditionalFormat.description: A closed, governed conditional-format binding over compiled result names.

DashboardConditionalStyle.description: A renderer-neutral color or icon intent applied by a conditional rule.

DashboardConditionalThreshold.description: One ordered numeric comparison in a rules-based conditional format.

DashboardDimensionReference.description: A semantic dimension reference. Physical dataset fields are not accepted.

DashboardDocument.description: The complete canonical Dashboard resource document.

DashboardIncludes.description: Typed local fragment collections. Includes are resolved before validation.

DashboardKPITrendBinding.description: A governed result frame used for a KPI sparkline trend.

DashboardKPIValueBinding.description: A governed numeric result used for a KPI comparison or goal.

DashboardMetricReference.description: A semantic metric reference. Metric expressions are never part of this type.

DashboardPageFilterBinding.description:
A page-scoped state binding for one governed dashboard filter definition.
The binding identity is local to its page and is independent from any
in-canvas filter component that presents the same filter.

DashboardPresentationBase.description: Renderer-neutral presentation policies; renderer options are intentionally absent.

axisVisible.description: Whether cartesian/value axes are rendered for this visual.

DashboardRecordFieldReference.description: A physical field reference is only valid for a records query root dataset.

DashboardResourceKind.description: Common resource kind for a dashboard document.

field.description: A compiled result-frame field name, never a source member or expression.

titleVisible.description: Controls whether the authored title is shown in the visual frame.

PointDashboardColorScale.description: A governed result-frame binding used by a point/scatter visual.

PointDashboardOverplot.description: Overplotting policy for a point/scatter visual.

PointDashboardPresentation.description: Strict point/scatter presentation and its governed result-frame channels.

PointDashboardSizeScale.description: Pixel and optional domain bounds for a governed point size binding.
